scope: Review monetary-condition coverage code and tests, frozen before-correction input reproducibility, full record retention, exact joins, null/empty handling, and the four manually declared DMG p.33 condition-omission regression contracts. This review does not assess source condition semantics beyond the supplied contract.

checks.nullEmptyAndAbsent: All records remain source-semantic-unassessed; no null, empty, or absent field is used as proof of printed-source absence.

fourManualContractRows.result: baseline identity confirmed against index and row audit

conditionChangeProbes.findingDisposition: the held pre-repair contract status remained present; none was automatically cleared

findings.summary: Declared contract exact binding omits source path, hash, and pointer comparison.
findings.evidence: Changed only one contract row's sourceInput.sha256, path, or jsonPointer; each probe still returned exact-pointer-and-before-value-match. Current baseline rows happen to match all three fields in index provenance and the row-audit record.
findings.recommendation: Require exact equality for the complete contract sourceInput triple against the indexed occurrence provenance and exact row-audit reference (and report mismatch as needs-review); add negative tests for each changed field.

findings.summary: CLI defaults and output labels are frozen before-correction even when current inputs are supplied by override.
findings.evidence: CLI can accept --index and --row-audit overrides, but the contract artifact and output artifact name remain before-correction. A changed condition becomes a generic contract-to-index-identity-mismatch while the confirmed-source-condition-omission-before-repair status persists.
findings.recommendation: For post-source-fix CI, add an explicit current mode that compares current rows to the frozen source contract, reports changed rows as needs-review, and retains each of the four findings until an independent disposition explicitly resolves it. Do not treat any text change, deletion, null, or rephrase as an automatic semantic pass.

limitations: This review checks the declared contracts and data plumbing, not printed-source completeness or semantic interpretation for all other rows.
The source row audit annotations are serialized evidence fields and are not independently source-validated by this tool.
The four source contracts remain manual reviewed obligations; the generic scanner does not discover semantic omissions.
